## Appearance

Charlotta has a freckled face featuring a snubbed nose and a wide mouth. She is known for her expansive smiles and wears a blue bow.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P58](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0058), [v3 ch.People P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007)_

## Personality

Charlotta is a warm-hearted handmaiden who shows sincere care and concern for her mistress. She harbors a strong dislike for [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) and experiences deep homesickness.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v3 ch.Again P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048)_

## History

Charlotta the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) was a young maid who worked for Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) when she was fourteen years old. She often entertained visiting guests alongside her employer, hosting pretend tea parties in the garden. Concerned by Miss Lavendar's frequent melancholy, Charlotta confided her worries to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne.md) to promise to visit more often. She later helped [Anne](../character/anne.md) prepare the house for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's return, anxiously waiting in the kitchen until she witnessed the couple's happy reconciliation. Charlotta subsequently assisted with the wedding preparations at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), eventually marrying a good-tempered bricklayer named Tom. Years later, she traveled back to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to attend Anne's wedding to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), +362 more_

## Quotes

> "it’s plain to be seen you and Miss Lavendar have got a secret and I think, begging your pardon if I’m too forward, Miss Shirley, ma’am, that it’s real mean not to tell me when we’ve all been such chums."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)

> "I peeked from the kitchen window . . . and he’s awful handsome . . . and just the right age for Miss Lavendar. And oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, do you think it would be much harm to listen at the door?"
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P65](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0065)

> "But I’m sure I shan’t sleep a blessed wink, Miss Shirley, ma’am, for fear that something’ll go wrong at the last minute . . . the cream won’t whip . . . or Mr. Irving’ll have a stroke and not be able to come."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014)

> "but there’s so much to do yet . . . and oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, I’m skeered it’s going to rain and I wish you’d get up and tell me you think it ain’t."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P19](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0019)

> "Yes, ma’am. Come in, ma’am. I’ll tell Miss Lavendar you’re here, ma’am. She’s upstairs, ma’am."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P40](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0040)

## Relationships

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--diana.md)

Charlotta acts as a friendly host to [Diana](../character/diana.md) whenever she visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), welcoming her and [Anne](../character/anne.md) warmly for tea parties and home visits. Over time, [Diana](../character/diana.md) continues to drop by [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) alongside [Anne](../character/anne.md), including helping out with Lavendar's wedding preparations and later visiting the stone house to air it out during college breaks.

- Friend of — welcomes her warmly at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta serves as the young maid and helper to Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Beyond her household duties, she cares deeply about her employer's emotional well-being, openly confiding her worries to [Anne](../character/anne.md) whenever [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) slips into melancholy moods. She assists [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) with daily chores, outdoor tea parties, and the extensive preparations leading up to Lavendar's wedding.

- Serves under — employer  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), +4 more</sub>
